steps.content: The comms device in your pocket buzzes. Walking behind everyone else, you take a peek at it.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Sorry, my little gray wolf. Though I promised to take part in this exciting play with you...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I really couldn't bear to let my little apple get off work late.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I put your clue under the sofa cushion by the door. Thanks and bye!
Your hands quiver somewhat after reading the message.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Huh? This seems to be an art gallery? But the door is locked, and there doesn't seem to be anyone inside... Did we come here for nothing?
"The door... is indeed locked. The adventurers are a bit shocked, but they calm down quickly."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Huh? What's the situation here...
"EMP is not the brightest of the bunch..."

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...Never mind, you're the game master. Whatever you say.
"The adventurers realize that since this... er, clue-peddling merchant... gave EMP a clue to begin with, he or she probably also anticipated the adventurers coming back for more."
"So the clever adventurers figured that the merchant either left more clues within sight, or... didn't leave at all."
Etti strokes her chin and thinks for a while, then orders Ninety-Nine to take Hella off the sofa and begins to search.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: This blue sofa has always been outside, so people of the bazaar are used to it. But to us who are here for the first time, it's a pretty obvious tip-off!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: To send a message through something that most locals have tuned out while knowing it would stick out to newcomers is a clever idea indeed.
In the gap between the sofa's cushions and back, Etti fishes out an old piece of paper with her fingers.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But... this clue is a bit weird...
The three others scuttle over curiously to look at the paper in Etti's hand—it depicts a drawing identical to the one that EMP has.
It's a giant dragon soaring forward with its wings spread and head raised high. However, this one is facing the other direction. Both drawings are symmetrical to the central axis.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey look, there's a poetic verse in the bottom right-hand corner of each one. Are they clues?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? You can recognize poetry...? Ouch, why are you kicking me?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Let me see...
Etti puts the merchant's clue below EMP's clue, piecing out a complete poem...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content:
"The hometown that I kissed is the place the wind blew cold."
"The dragon's head always faces the light, which is the way that I must go."

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhh... I sort of get it, but don't get it at the same time.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Just admit that you don't get it. There's no such thing as sort of...
The team stares at the identical dragons and falls silent again.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The place the wind blew cold... is that referring to the direction of the wind?
Ninety-Nine asks this as she tucks the hair lifted by the night breeze behind her ear.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Wind... direction... symmetrical dragons...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I get it now!
Etti picks up two wooden sticks from the ground and smears them with some drool that had fallen when EMP and Hella were fighting.
She sticks the two pieces of paper symmetrically on the sticks, then holds them up with a loose grip.
The wind blows by, turning the sticks around and moving the dragons' bodies. Everyone sees the dragon's heads swaying in the wind, pointing out the way forward.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I knew it! The legendary castle is that way!
Etti jumps up in excitement with both hands up high.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It must be a dark, dangerous castle full of traps! Only a castle like that can imprison light and be worth it for me to conquer!
Your shackles twitch instinctively. You look at Etti's glowing eyes and frown slightly.
"The adventurers deciphered the merchant's clue and learned of the legendary castle's location."
"It is a dangerous path laden with hardships and obstacles. The adventurers might be devoured by the darkness with the slightest misstep."
"But the adventurers believe in themselves—and also their companions."
Etti's gleaming eyes gradually return to normal. She looks at the others behind her, then at you. Then, without saying a word, she beckons for you to follow her and sets off.
"Just like that, the four adventurers chosen by fate—Etti the Mage, Ninety-Nine the Barbarian, Hella the Rogue and EMP the Bard—sets off towards the darkness to restore the light."
Deep in the night, you bring the adventurers to a remote corner of Eastside. A house almost completely shrouded in darkness appears before everyone's eyes.
"The adventurers can't see the entire castle clearly in the darkness of night, but the ominous roars carried out from inside by the wind betrays its gloom and terror."
There are messy stones and broken barbed wire everywhere. The teams stop outside the fence to discuss what to do.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Etti? Why don't you say something? You always have the most ideas. Tell us how we should attack and give that "Dreadlord" a surprise!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...I don't know.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You don't know? E-e-e-even you don't know?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Th-then what's inside must really be...
Etti sighs, puts back her previous expression, and pats EMP.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What I mean is, the mystery is what makes it exciting.
Half of Etti's face is immersed in the darkness of the night, while the flickering neon lights nearby cast an eerie glow on her face.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Dragons are fearless, mighty, dominating creatures...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: As a messenger and representative of the dragons, I have no fear of the unknown! Fear itself should fear my might!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: As for you...
Etti opens her arms to her companions, as if wanting to hug and restrain them at the same time.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: My dear companions... and guides of fate... since you are with me... you must be strong enough and worthy of accompanying me.
Before Etti's smile disappears, she picks up her staff and leads everyone towards the "castle" step by step.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I hope my God of Fate has arranged the most exciting battle for me in this legendary castle!
The "castle" gates creak open.
There are no ghosts, no monsters, or any other spooky scenes from their imaginations—just endless darkness that seems to devour something new with each step they take.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't like this place...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: This is worse than seeing ghosts or monsters...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: This environment can make people agitated.
"The boundless darkness makes the adventurers realize that if all the light gets devoured one day, every corner of the world will end up like this castle."
"And all the people who came here bravely did so to prevent that from happening."
"The adventurers' courage and kindness transform into rays of light, bursting out from their chests to illuminate the darkness..."
"And they finally see the light-devouring, darkness-spreading Dreadlord inside the castle..."
A pale light resembling the one in the interrogation room switches on. Under this light, everyone sees... the Dreadlord.
The "Dreadlord" sits in the center of the magic circle, holding a... picture book.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: "Hmph hmph hmph╭(╯^╰)╮"

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: "Puny adventurers!"

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: "I know why you've come! However! To get the magic box, you must defeat me first!"

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: "Yet defeating me is an impossible task!"
In the face of the "Dreadlord's" provocations, Etti slowly opens her eyes, like a dragon fixating on a treasure.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Did you know, dragons are often considered the last and strongest of the great beasts.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So... a Dreadlord is nothing by comparison.
With a swish of her cape, Etti stands in front of the Dreadlord with her head raised high and begins to arrange the adventurers' attack order.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Rogue, take the lead in the first round and neutralize all the traps around the Dreadlord!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, leave it to me!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Barbarian, you're next. Deal a painful blow to the Dreadlord with your berserk skill!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Okay.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Bard, when it's your turn, keep releasing your flash arrows and paralyze the Dreadlord for at least two rounds.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: No problem. I got it covered!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Finally, give me one minute.
Etti raises her staff and slams it hard on the floor.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I will turn this place into a frozen tundra!
The dice of fate starts to spin.
Under the command of such an outstanding Mage, the four adventurers' consecutive attacks gradually put the seemingly invincible Dreadlord into a losing position.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: D-despicable! Just you wait!

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Um, hey, God of Fate? I remember that I had a siege crossbow?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Huh? But isn't that for knocking down the city wall? No way... would the Dreadlord have something like that?!
Hehe. If the God of Fate says it is so, then it is so.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: You four scoundrels! Taste this!
The Dreadlord rips open the picture book, revealing a sketch of a powerful siege crossbow.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh my gosh! That thing will turn us into minced meat!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Things... aren't looking good.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Etti...!! Think of something!
Grinning, the Dreadlord aims and shoots the powerful crossbow at the four adventurers!
The adventurers have no time to react! The crossbow strike leaves them scattered and riddled with scars.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Impossible! They should have been defeated by now! Why are they still alive?
Failing to hear any announcement of the adventurers' defeat from the "God of Fate"/game master, the Dreadlord becomes quite flustered.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ha... Haha!
With the support of her staff, Etti gets up slowly, dusts off her face, and stares defiantly at the Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You think I'd come face you off unprepared?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Sorry to disappoint you—I already cast a defensive spell on my companions long before we came in.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha, so... your Ultimate won't kill us!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It hurts, but I bet you didn't expect us to survive! We can still fight!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hmph! I will make you taste my wrath!
In the face of these circumstances, the Dreadlord silently lowers her head, as if deeply aware of her precarious situation.
Excellent... Truly outstanding adventurers.
A cold, female voice suddenly echoes from behind the Dreadlord, sending a chill down everyone's spines.
Everyone stares into the dark vortex. After a while, a green-haired woman emerges and takes the place of the Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: It's already quite impressive that you were able to defeat my "doppelganger"...

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Though I really want to defeat you, I realized there's something I want to do even more.
The real Dreadlord lifts up her hand and points at Etti.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Your teammates are feeble, but you're a hundred times stronger than them... How about ditching them to join me?

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Darkness and dragons have always been best friends. If we join hands... this world is ours.
After hearing what the Dreadlord said, Hella can't help but blurt out...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you plotting?! There's no way Etti would listen to you! Right?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yeah! Why would I listen to you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Look!
Etti approaches the Dreadlord step by step, her radiant eyes gleaming.
The Dreadlord frowns and looks at Etti in puzzlement.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: To join you and stand by your side...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What an uninteresting proposal... How can you face your enemies with such thoughts?
A bit unnerved by Etti's words, the Dreadlord sneaks a glance at you.

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Oh? Then... what would you consider to be interesting?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: If I were in control of this game, what would I do?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I... would sacrifice all my companions to the darkness.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh?!
Etti laughs, somewhat maniacally.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Then... I'd mix all of you together to create a stepping stone to world domination!

steps.speaker: Dreadlord
steps.content: Wait! Chief...!!
Etti doesn't wait for the Dreadlord to finish speaking. With a sudden wave of her hand, the surrounding darkness springs to life and consumes her, then rushes towards everyone else!
Etti! Stop!! What are you doing? Are you trying to create another Aesthia?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: No... of course not.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But you're not completely wrong.
As Etti manipulates the darkness, you can't see her expression clearly.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: From the moment I stepped in here, I knew... that it was me who devoured the light.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I know what this place is... But now, it's nothing but pitch darkness... Before, whenever I opened the door, I'd see all the different game worlds he made.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Grandpa would assume the role of different NPCs and take me into the game world... No matter how lonely I was outside, I wouldn't be alone when I came here.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But I almost lost those warm memories... Even when I regained them, I'd soon forget them again whenever happier memories appear... What should I do?!
More and more darkness springs forth from under Etti's feet, ensnaring the white light above her head. Light is about to vanish completely.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, you're so much trouble! I don't want to play anymore! If you think it's better this way... then just cast me to the darkness.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Yeah, if you like this ending better, just pretend that we adventurers lost and you became the Dreadlord. You win!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You're... not scared of losing?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: It's okay to lose. I lose to Hella and Chief all the time. It's just a game. Having fun is what counts.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: None of you get it...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I get it. Memories are what keep a person going. They fuel one's life and actions.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But I'm doing fine right now. I haven't forgotten, nor will I ever forget. Yet I will also make myself happy.
Etti's hand trembles. She bites her lower lip, as if trying to hold back her emotions.
Yet the next second, the darkness still devours everyone except you and Etti.
Etti, don't make this a repeat of the Isle of Sky. Total control will only make you lose control!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Lose control...? But I already have complete control over this place, and also mastered your weakness—these people.
The surrounding scenery begins to change. You're suddenly surrounded by the red spiritual world, while Etti's eyes look the same as they did on the Isle of Sky.
It's a look that only a gamemaster can have—one that exudes total control.
I see...
It's a pity, because like you said, I'm the "God of Fate."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ha! So what?
Fate... will always set you on the right path.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: That's true! But... I've always relished deviating from the path set for me by fate.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Of course, I also respect fate...
With a wave of her hand, Etti takes out a star-speckled die.
You recognize it as Etti's special die. You can guess what Etti wants to do, so you take out your own pure white Chosen One.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You should know the rules already, but I still want to make it clear to you...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I control this place. Even if you win... I will find a way to subvert you.
Now that I wield fate itself... I believe the God of Fate will stand by my side.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: All right. Good luck to you, then.
With a flick of her wrist, Etti casts the die into the air. You also cast your die, and the two collide.
The pair of dice gradually slow down. You can feel your heart beating faster and faster.
The spiritual world's sea of red flowers gradually expands. The power of Mania is growing stronger and stronger...
The pair of dice lands softly on the ground, marking the end of the duel between fate and power.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Dear God of Fate...
The gleam in Etti's eyes brightens, and her smile gets ever more eerier.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You were born to be subverted.
Everything suddenly quiets down. The thick darkness quickly envelops your whole body, eroding your mind and senses.
In your last moment of consciousness, you feel a powerful gush of Mania rushing towards you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Goodbye, dear Chief.
Yet when the shudders and ringing in your ears subside, what you had expected didn't actually take place.
Slowly, you try to open your eyes...
Basking in the soft light, you spot the one smiling mischievously before you.
You better explain this to me...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Aww, why so serious?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I-I was just joking around...
Just joking around?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What, you want to put on airs and lecture me about rules now? This "interrogation" of yours was nonsense from the very beginning!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You want to get back at me because you got humiliated on the Isle of Sky? You want to use this game to "give me a taste of my own medicine?" Hmph, should I call you brave or naive?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Plus, you're not a very professional game master. You're always trying to find ways to counter me. It's already quite magnanimous of me to hold out this long before exploding.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So I wanted to show you how to control the game like a professional game master!
What about everyone else?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Don't worry, they're here...
Etti waves her hands, and the dark shadows dissipate instantly. Hella, Ninety-Nine, and EMP are all sitting on the ground in confusion.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah... ah!! I'm still alive!! Hahaha!! That's great!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're so loud!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: ...Is it all over?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yeah, sort of...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Oh wait, there's one more person...
Etti takes you to the attic. When you open the door, you see your mild-tempered adjutant sitting at the desk, smiling kindly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, Etti, if possible, when we get back to the Bureau, I want you to tell me in detail what... the... heck... happened!
After Nightingale leaves the attic, both the mighty dragon and unyielding fate sigh in relief.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Don't be so cocky next time. Judging from this sloppy game of yours, you have a long way to go before you can challenge me.
...The Isle of Sky aside, I do have a real treasure. Since you did clear the level, it's yours to keep. I guess this can count as having completed the game on my part.
To Etti's surprise, you give her the handmade book that Nightingale left behind.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Is this... my grandpa's handmade book?

Yeah. Sorry, I didn't mean to read something he left you on purpose. At the time, you were clutching it tightly, and we moved it aside to let you sleep better. However, it accidentally flipped open in the process.
It was then that I found a hidden compartment at the end of the book.
The hidden compartment seems to have remnants of the Dragon of Genesis' power. I'm guessing there's a gift inside that your grandpa wants you to have once you're truly able to "control everything."
Etti goes to the last page of the book and gently taps on the handmade wooden cover. The muffled sound tells her that there is a hidden compartment.
She opens the compartment to find a letter that has been there for a long, long time.
Etti opens the letter and reads it in silence for a long time.
She doesn't speak again until the dawn light emerges in the horizon.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Actually... I panicked when I came back into this house. I thought I had lost my memory again from being immersed in my own game.
Etti gazes at the letter in her hands, then folds it up and puts it in her shirt pocket.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But... thank you for being willing to trust me, tolerate me, and for letting me know...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: That when memories are overlaid by trust, happiness, and sincerity, they are not forgotten... They are simply tucked away like treasures.

Etti, I assume that by the time you read this letter, you've already completed the game I made?

Did you have fun?

I believe you must be quite happy, and that you also have trusty friends by your side. Am I right?

Hehe... If this is the case, then you can safely tuck me away into the deepest, darkest corner of your heart. I'll guard you against fear and loneliness...

...Until you turn all this darkness into joy.

—Guardian of Darkness - Genesis Gamemaster - Black Dragon - Old Wach
